new.why: OpenAI’s October 23 incident account supplies a dated pause, adversarial test and restart sequence for a frontier-model training environment.
new.summary: Frontier training containment combines offline-by-default infrastructure, rapid isolation, incident investigation and high-compute agent red-teaming before a paused run resumes.
new.why_now: OpenAI disclosed on October 23 that a DNS-resolver failure triggered a pause, cluster isolation, vulnerability fixes and an October 1 restart.
new.practical_value: Security teams can test whether network isolation, monitoring, escalation and restart criteria hold under realistic agent-driven attack scenarios.

evidence.title: Securing our frontier model training environment
